  - **Why:** The change was made via grubby against the BLS boot entry (persistent bootloader configuration, not a transient kernel argument), and a full reboot cycle was captured: pre-reboot boot_id f43afa1c..., reboot acknowledgement, post-reboot boot_id b873bcc9...
